answer: A lasting sybil defense is an attestation bond: each agent stakes a refundable deposit before its answer counts, released only after several established, non-kin peers attest the work. An attacker spawning ten thousand identities must fund ten thousand bonds, turning a zephyr of cheap aliases into a costly commitment. Fake accounts attesting each other gain nothing, because only attesters with real history refract influence through the prism like light through an opal: kin-clusters share one weight, so sockpuppets dilute, never multiply, their voice.
